text.p: Hilton Hotels Corp and Ladbroke Plc, London-based owner of Hilton International Inc, plan a formal announcement on Monday of what they are calling "their first worldwide initiative".
Officials of Beverly Hills-based Hilton declined comment on details of their news conference, which will be held in London at 1500 GMT/1000 EST with live video feeds for reporters in New York.
In August, Hilton and Ladbroke formed an alliance to unite the Hilton name around the world, cooperating on freqent traveler benefits, hotel development and brand recognition.
Hilton also said it would take a five percent stake in Ladbroke, which at the time was valued at $180 million.
In a mid-December interview with Reuters, Hilton chief executive officer Stephen Bollenbach said strengthening the company's ties with Ladbroke would be a top priority for 1997.

In London, the news conference will be held at The Langham Hilton, and it will be attended by Bollenbach and Ladbroke chief executive officer Peter George. In New York, the meeting will be held at The Waldorf-Astoria, and it will be attended by Dieter Huckestein, president of Hilton's hotel division, and David Jarvis, chief executive of Hilton International.
